name: Dijkstra's Shortest Path Algorithm
summary: Finds the shortest paths between nodes in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights using a priority queue (min-heap).
best_for: Network routing, GPS navigation, pathfinding on non-negative graphs.

name: A* Pathfinding Algorithm
summary: Informed graph search algorithm that finds the shortest path by combining actual cost g(n) with heuristic estimated distance h(n): f(n) = g(n) + h(n).
best_for: Game AI, robotics spatial navigation, 2D grid pathing.

name: LRU Cache (Least Recently Used)
summary: Combines a doubly-linked list with a hash map to evict the least recently used element when capacity is reached in constant time.
best_for: In-memory database buffers, web page caches, OS virtual memory paging.

name: Topological Sort (Kahn's Algorithm)
summary: Produces a linear ordering of vertices in a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) such that for every directed edge u -> v, u comes before v.
best_for: Build systems (Make/Gradle task dependencies), course prerequisite planning, package managers.

name: Levenshtein Edit Distance
summary: Measures minimum single-character edits (insertions, deletions, substitutions) required to transform string A into string B.
best_for: Fuzzy string matching, spell checking, DNA sequence alignment, search autocorrect.

name: Consistent Hashing with Virtual Nodes
summary: Maps both nodes and data keys to a hash ring, minimizing key remapping during server additions or removals to 1/N of keys.
best_for: Distributed caching (Memcached), load balancing, Cassandra/DynamoDB partition routing.
